summary: Since v1.16.0, Vite SSR builds produce broken bundles when importing workflow modules, emitting bare deep imports without `.js` extensions and absolute filesystem paths that won't resolve at runtime.
userImpact: Users cannot build and deploy Vite SSR applications that import workflow modules, causing production failures with unresolved module errors.
rootCause: Package re-export structure changes in 1.16.0 (Nexus API restructuring) cause Rollup/Vite to see through externalized packages and emit deep-path imports to CJS files instead of treating the package as opaque.
proposedFix: Define cross-package entry points using package.json exports field (#2079) to prevent bare deep imports without proper resolution paths.
workaround: Refactor host code to use string workflow names and type-only imports for typing, avoiding direct workflow module imports in the SSR bundle.
keyQuote: emit direct deep-path imports to the underlying CJS files instead of treating the package as opaque
